summary: Closes the two gaps the GFX-COPIER-REALTIME-HYBRID-PREDEMO-READINESS-072 assessment measured (NOT_READY). (1) ADR-0096 event-driven post-fill follower-ticket binding: new backend/trade_copier/open_result_binding.py (bind_open_result) binds CopierReplication.follower_ticket DIRECTLY from the OPEN order's fill result at the single job-completion convergence point (execution.ExecutionJobViewSet.complete), with NO /mt5/positions read, so the LIVE account_not_demo wall no longer blocks linkage; SUCCESS+positive-int ticket -> bind + reconciliation_status=MATCHED + status=EXECUTION_VERIFIED (mirrors the ADR-0087 mutation SUCCESS write), SUCCESS no/invalid ticket -> UNKNOWN (binds nothing; positions-read reconcile remains the fallback), FAILED -> EXECUTION_FAILED; idempotent, conflict fails closed (never overwrites; logs unconditionally + governed alert), anti-cross-bind (the replication must own the job), select_for_update, fully fail-safe (never breaks job completion). Consequence: MODIFY/FULL-CLOSE no longer hard-depend on COPIER_FOLLOWER_READONLY_POSITIONS_ENABLED for the common path. (2) #46 real-time SOURCE reuse: the ADR-0077 emitter bundle signs with the SAME trade_copier.event_ingestion module the endpoint verifies with, pinned by new tests_emitter_ingest_contract.py for the exact #46/55442/Tradersway-Live OPEN->MODIFY->CLOSE lifecycle; what remains is host-side operational only, documented in docs/COPIER_REALTIME_SOURCE_ACTIVATION.md. No new flag, no new model, NO migration. DARK/default-OFF; no deploy, no host contact, no secret provisioning, no flag enablement, no broker order.
root_cause: The 072 readiness returned NOT_READY for two independent reasons: (a) no master-side real-time SOURCE is wired to production #46 (ingested_revisions_total=0 - the ADR-0077 emitter bundle exists but is not installed/armed on the host, so every #46 event is POLL-sourced); and (b) the fast path had no post-fill binding of the follower ticket - the only linker was the ADR-0074 positions-read reconcile, which a LIVE follower bridge refuses with account_not_demo unless the route-scoped read flag is armed, so a copied LIVE OPEN could not be linked and the governed MODIFY/FULL-CLOSE (which require a MATCHED, non-null follower_ticket) stayed fail-closed.

adversarial_review.money_path: SAFE on all vectors: duplicate/replayed completion (409 guard + idempotent same-ticket), timeout-then-late-success (no retry, no second order), contradictory tickets (ownership guard + conflict fail-closed, never overwrite), MODIFY-before-OPEN and CLOSE-after-UNKNOWN (fail-closed on no_verified_follower_ticket), cross-route substitution (payload rep-id + rep.execution_job_id ownership guard), non-copier/non-PLACE_ORDER (inert), forged/malformed ticket (int>0 + bool/float rejected; a non-matching ticket resolves to nothing at positions_get - never a wrong position, since MT5 tickets are globally unique), VERIFIED invariant (only on SUCCESS + positive broker-reported ticket), reconcile interaction (bound row excluded from both reconcile selectors; first writer wins), fail-safe HTTP (job write already committed; double-wrapped), select_for_update (own atomic), no order/allowance/broker contact, kill-switch/expiry (binding grants no authority; MODIFY/CLOSE re-gate under lock), ungated-by-design (inert in DARK; required for containment).
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_1_order_vs_position_ticket: FIXED + DOCUMENTED. The signal bridge's normal OPEN result reports the opening ORDER ticket in result['ticket']; the governed MODIFY/CLOSE resolve by the POSITION ticket. For a position-clean fresh open (the governed route precondition) they are EQUAL, so the bind is correct; a NETTING follower with a pre-existing same-symbol position (forbidden by the route's position-clean precondition) is the one divergence, where the bound order ticket resolves to NOTHING at positions_get -> MODIFY/CLOSE fail CLOSED (never the wrong position) and the ADR-0057 operator-manual-close fallback applies. Fix: _result_ticket now PREFERS an explicit position/position_ticket field whenever a bridge surfaces one (the lost-ACK recovery result already carries the position ticket), falling back to ticket. Regression test_prefers_position_ticket_over_order_ticket. Surfacing the position ticket in every bridge OPEN result is a bridge-side follow-up (out of backend scope). Documented in ADR-0096 + the module docstring + KNOWN_ISSUES.
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_2_silent_conflict_when_alerts_off: FIXED. The conflicting-ticket branch now emits an UNCONDITIONAL logger.error (independent of the default-OFF governed alert) so an integrity-class event is never silent; the governed de-duplicated alert is still raised; the bound ticket is never overwritten. A ticket is an audit identifier, not a secret.
adversarial_review.LOW_findings: Reviewed: (a) the rep.execution_job_id in (None, job.id) allowance is defensive and not exploitable (copier payloads are stamped only by sanctioned producers) - kept intentionally for linkage-lag resilience; (b) ticket coercion now rejects bool and fractional floats (regression tests test_bool_ticket_is_unknown + test_fractional_ticket_is_unknown); (c) oversized ticket -> save raises -> contained (fails closed); (d) idempotent-after-reconcile leaving status=EXECUTION_REQUESTED is cosmetic (lifecycle admission keys on MATCHED + non-null ticket, not on EXECUTION_VERIFIED).
adversarial_review.secrets_pii: SAFE - broker_result stores the bridge result dict (ticket/price/volume/symbol/sl/tp/comment/retcode), no login/password/token; the conflict alert redacts the ticket; no secret in any log.
